Lemma
[Distance to a superlevel set] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0470, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0471, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0472 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h36-unique-generalized-gradient 1. apph:H.54\group Integral curves

For $f(y_0)<f_{\sup }$ and $\epsilon >0$, there are a neighborhood $\mathcal U$ of $y_0$ and $s_\epsilon >0$ such that \[ \frac{s}{d_C(y,y^s)}\ge |\nabla f(y_0)|-\epsilon \] for $y\in C\cap \mathcal U$ and $0<s<s_\epsilon $, where $y^s$ is a nearest point in the superlevel set $\{ f\ge f(y)+s\} $.
